title: Partnership lockup
slide_intent: Teach designers how to show two identities as peers. Optical alignment, clear space and relative scale affect which partner appears to carry more weight.
strategic_value: Slack can identify a partnership clearly while preserving a distinct signature for each organization.
demonstration: A horizontal example aligns Slack and a partner along their optical baselines. A stacked alternative places Slack above the partner. Pale guides explain the spacing and dividing line.
practical_value: Choose the arrangement for the available space, give the marks comparable apparent size and use the octothorpe as the gap measure. Use the full Slack logo as shown.

content_islands.name: Partnership directions
content_islands.spec: Set the approved use, placement and restrictions in the left column. Keep the list beneath the construction notes.

content_islands.name: Horizontal pairing
content_islands.spec: Show Slack on the left and the partner mark on the right. Bisect the clear space with a rule and annotate the baseline and gap.

content_islands.name: Stacked pairing
content_islands.spec: Place the full Slack logo above a partner placeholder. Use faint octothorpe guides to show how spacing carries into the alternate arrangement.
